text: ADVANCE. One trigger: hourly close above bar_high 644.24 on 1.4x time-of-day volume, void once price is past pivot_high+10%. On C17, 6.12 past the pivot is a late buy carrying a warning, not a rejection and not a wait: my reservation is no add-ons (C21) and, on C23, MA beside held V means force out the weaker, not widen. A pull-in to ma_20 is not an O'Neil buy point; the pivot is. Wrong if a close back under pivot_high. Cannot see EPS C/A, sponsors, base stage; C1 market gate delegated.
